description: Defines the opacity gradient model. Opacity ω is a continuous parameter in [0,1] characterizing the degree to which a structure conceals its internal configuration from external observers.

endpoint_semantics.0.0: Fully transparent — all internal configuration exposed to any observer with δ > 0
endpoint_semantics.1.0: Fully opaque — no internal configuration accessible regardless of observer detection capacity

binary_cases.note: Binary opacity assignments are special cases of the continuous gradient, not a distinct model.

opacity_zones.label: High Transparency
opacity_zones.description: Most internal configuration accessible to observers with moderate detection capacity. Concealment is minimal or incidental.

opacity_zones.label: Partial Opacity
opacity_zones.description: Significant structure accessible but meaningful concealment present. Revelation requires deliberate detection effort.

opacity_zones.label: Partial Concealment
opacity_zones.description: More structure concealed than revealed under standard detection capacity. Elevated δ required for revelation.

opacity_zones.label: High Opacity
opacity_zones.description: Majority of internal configuration concealed. Revelation requires exceptional detection capacity or structural transformation.

opacity_sources.label: Structural Complexity
opacity_sources.description: Internal configuration exceeds observer resolution — not deliberate concealment but emergent opacity from depth.

opacity_sources.label: Deliberate Information Hiding
opacity_sources.description: Structure is explicitly configured to expose only a bounded interface while concealing internal relations.

opacity_sources.label: Encoding Depth
opacity_sources.description: Internal configuration is nested multiple sub-structure levels deep; each level contributes additive opacity.

opacity_sources.label: Interface Abstraction
opacity_sources.description: An abstraction layer is interposed between the observer and internal configuration, acting as an opacity surface.

opacity_sources.label: Temporal Opacity
opacity_sources.description: Structure is visible only within narrow time windows; outside those windows ω approaches 1.0 regardless of δ.

assignment_procedure: 1. Identify the target structure S and enumerate its declared interfaces.
2. Assess the ratio of exposed to total internal configuration.
3. Assign ω ∈ [0,1] such that ω = 0 implies full exposure and ω = 1 implies complete concealment.
4. Record opacity source(s) from OS-001 through OS-005.
5. Confirm INV-OR-003: ω is a property of S, not of any observer. Record ω as fixed for this S configuration.
structural_note: Opacity is a property of the structure's configuration (INV-OR-003). The same ω value holds regardless of which observer attempts detection. Observers with different δ may reach different revelation states, but ω itself does not change.
